site.name: IdeoLab
site.description: IdeoLab is an AI business creation workspace that helps people move from business information and ideas to finished marketing work without constantly rebuilding the project in separate tools. Research, Understand, Create, Repurpose, Publish, Measure, Improve, Automate.

knowledge.note: Read voice-guide.md first, it outranks older tone guidance. Then brand-brief.md in full. Look the chosen capability up in feature-index.md, then read its full section in marketing-source-of-truth.md. Read the matching Side A or Side B chapters of icp-profile.md.

content.author: IdeoLab Team
content.audience: One of two readers, chosen per article and recorded in frontmatter as audience_side. Side A: an agency owner, consultant or growth operator who already knows marketing and wants more capacity, client value and recurring revenue without more payroll. Side B: an established business owner or in-house marketer whose business is better than its online presence and who wants consistent, credible marketing without becoming a full-time content producer. Both read on a phone between other work. Full profiles in knowledge/icp-profile.md.
content.voiceNotes: Direct response, conversational, written to one person. See knowledge/voice-guide.md, which is the authority on tone. Never invent a term. Open with a moment or a claim, never with homework. Concrete over abstract. Contractions fine. Product mentioned only after the reader recognises the problem.

cover.styleNotes: Match the covers already on the site in public/images/blog: a soft 3D render on a plain pale blue to white gradient, one clear central object, matte rounded surfaces, even studio lighting, a soft shadow underneath. Palette is brand blue #2f7cf0, light blue #8ebdff, ink navy #16283a for small details and CTA orange #f97316 as a small accent only. No photography, no people, no text or numbers in the image, no logos, no realistic product UI, no readable charts. The object must say what the article is about at a glance. Describe the intended cover in the cover_brief frontmatter field first.
